affected_boundaries: frozen worker authorization to native command approval

observed_behavior: Production adapter declines a required semantic rebase despite the explicitly authorized active edit lease.
expected_behavior: The exact leased worker can replay its commit against the freshly fetched configured campaign base.
causal_mechanism: Production unconditionally declined native approval requests while acceptance fixtures supplied a separate narrow approval handler.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Acceptance tests provide authorization behavior absent from the production native transport adapter.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Fixture success conceals the operational denial encountered by real workers.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Native approval must preserve current lease and exact actor/turn/checkout scope while permitting the required authorized replay operation.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Resolve current worker context and dispatch from the durable store; validate its marker and campaign base; approve only documented exact replay commands once.

applicability_conditions: Required worker Git replay crosses the linked checkout sandbox boundary.
known_non_matches: Foreign actors, unknown turns, inspection-only leases and unrelated commands do not inherit rebase authority.
confirmation_evidence: Native controlled protocol accepts exact leased replay and rejects mismatches and command injection.
regression_proofs: tests/rolling-worker.test.ts: worker instructions retain exact obligation, requirement, acceptance step, lease and QA selections
